title: TPM 2.0：PCR量測、Quote 與新鮮度
titleEn: TPM 2.0: PCR measurements, quotes and freshness
subcategoryTitle: 作業系統隔離與硬體信任根
subcategoryTitleEn: Operating-system isolation and hardware roots of trust
summary: 用合成開機事件序列示範PCR延伸H(舊PCR||事件digest)；列出quote簽章、選取PCR、nonce及event log各自驗證責任。
summaryEn: Use a synthetic boot-event sequence to illustrate PCR extension H(old PCR||event digest); separate quote signature, selected PCRs, nonce and event-log checks.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

options: 證明失敗可能是正常更新改變量測參考，或收到舊quote；兩者不可一律當硬體被入侵。
對更新建立版本化參考與審核，保留nonce與驗證時刻；不要將能通過一次quote等同系統持續沒有惡意。
TPM可保存平台量測相關狀態並對特定資料簽署證明；可信判讀仍需要參考值與新鮮挑戰。
optionsEn: Attestation failure may reflect a legitimate update changing reference measurements or an old quote; neither should automatically be labeled hardware compromise.
Version and review update references, retain nonce/time and avoid equating one passing quote with continuous absence of malware.
A TPM holds measurement-related state and can sign attestations; trustworthy appraisal still needs reference values and a fresh challenge.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: TPM可保存平台量測相關狀態並對特定資料簽署證明；可信判讀仍需要參考值與新鮮挑戰。
knowledge.textEn: A TPM holds measurement-related state and can sign attestations; trustworthy appraisal still needs reference values and a fresh challenge.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 用合成開機事件序列示範PCR延伸H(舊PCR||事件digest)；列出quote簽章、選取PCR、nonce及event log各自驗證責任。
knowledge.textEn: Use a synthetic boot-event sequence to illustrate PCR extension H(old PCR||event digest); separate quote signature, selected PCRs, nonce and event-log checks.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 若選取n個SHA-256 PCR值，原始digest資料量=32n位元組；不含簽章、選擇位圖與quote其他結構，量測不同不直接等於惡意。
knowledge.textEn: Selecting n SHA-256 PCR values yields 32n raw digest bytes, excluding signature, selection bitmap and other quote structures; differing measurements do not automatically imply malice.
